verdict.rationale: OpenTofu ships an official, extensively documented CLI (`tofu`) with commands like plan, apply, test, import, and flags for scripting/automation (-out, -exclude, etc.), confirmed by docs and a direct probe of the CLI docs page. This gives AI-native users a stable, scriptable interface for infrastructure automation. Missing for 10: no evidence of AI-specific tooling such as structured/JSON output flags, agent-oriented guides, or MCP-style integrations tailored for AI consumption.
